question_text: A 5-day-old boy is brought to see his pediatrician after his newborn blood screening showed elevated levels of immunoreactive trypsinogen, a marker for cystic fibrosis. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation after regular prenatal care. He has 2 siblings that tested negative on screening. On physical exam, his vitals are normal and he appears healthy. Which of the following tests should be performed next to evaluate the newborn for cystic fibrosis?
